note: Recommendations for the unresolved readings, from the contract text only. None is applied: each waits for the user's approval. Billed invoices were not used to form any of them. Hand-maintained.
principle: Where Part IX speaks specifically to a point and states its reason, it is read as operative over a general provision or an illustrative form; the contract never ranks Part IX (AMB-01), so every recommendation that relies on it carries that uncertainty.

recommendations.basis: Clause 21 is the pricing clause for DD-120 and charges 'per circulating hour'; Appendix A defines circulating hours as hours drilling fluid is pumped through the tool. Back-reaming hours are charged separately as RM-530 (cl. 30, Schedule 8), so reading B would charge the same hours under two items.
recommendations.uncertain: Schedule 8 says 'circulating or back-reaming hour'; if Schedule 8 were ranked as a Schedule prevailing over Part III (cl. 2), B would govern. Schedule 8 is not listed in cl. 2.

recommendations.basis: The contract fixes the well class by call-off (cl. 4, P2, P3), and no call-off is supplied. The invoice header is the contractor's statement of it, constant for every well. Reading B leaves every class-rated service unpriceable. PD-210/PD-201 eligibility (the nominated performance section) stays a flag for the audit phase either way.
recommendations.uncertain: Whether any stated class is true; which 12-1/4" and 8-1/2" sections were nominated for performance drilling.

recommendations.basis: Clause 2 ranks only Schedules over Parts and Part VI over Parts I-V. Ranking by name (B) is not in the text; treating cl. 2 as exhaustive (C) would discard the Schedule of Variations and instruments the pricing depends on. Each conflict is settled through its own switch.
recommendations.uncertain: Every recommendation that relies on Part IX, Schedule 2C/2D/8 or Appendix G.

recommendations.basis: Clause 17B speaks to PD-210 specifically and gives its reason ('Schedule 2 having already priced the metre by depth'). The contract's own worked invoice (Appendix B, an HPHT well) prices PD-210 at the unfactored band rates 58.15 and 76.45.
recommendations.uncertain: The Schedule 2 note and the Schedule 3 Part 2 list name PD-210 as class-rated, and cl. 2 ranks a Schedule over a Part if Part IX is a Part.

recommendations.basis: Clause 17B says the hole-section factor is not applied on a Standby day and gives the reason ('the section not being drilled'); Clause 18 only states the general order. No example contradicts it (the Appendix B Standby line is not section-rated).
recommendations.uncertain: Rank of Part IX against Part III (AMB-01).

recommendations.basis: Clause 17A is an operative pricing clause and Schedule 2C restates it, calling the Schedule 1 rates of MW-310 and HC-620 'base rates'. Appendix B is a form of invoice; it also ignores 21A, so it does not reflect Part IX at all.
recommendations.uncertain: Appendix B is listed in cl. 2 while Part IX and Schedule 2C are not; the index does not affect January 2025 (index 100.00).

recommendations.basis: 21A deducts 'the first hour of each period in the hole'; Appendix A defines a BHA run as 'the period from the running of a bottom hole assembly into the hole to its recovery' - the same period. The deduction is taken before the 6-hour minimum, because 21A defines the Chargeable Hour the minimum counts.
recommendations.uncertain: 21A's second sentence ('the report states the hours run; the invoice charges one fewer') also fits a per-day deduction (A); Appendix B makes no deduction at all (C).

current_reading.note: The recommendation above (PER_BHA_RUN) was superseded; the approved reading is now PER_DAY_THEN_MINIMUM. The LOW grade used for AMB-05 is the evidential grade of that CURRENT reading, not a grade inherited from the superseded recommendation: 'period in the hole' (21A, with Appendix A's BHA-run definition) still admits a credible per-run reading, Appendix B's example makes no deduction at all, and the per-run alternative clears real findings (e.g. MDS-01877).

recommendations.basis: Each instrument says: 'Where this instrument and an earlier instrument both state a rate ... the later governs services performed on or after its effective date'. 'Earlier instrument' is ordered by issue (the Schedule of Variations reads them 'in the order issued'), so Amendment No. 3 (issued last) governs DD-120 from 1 February 2026, including the months Supplement No. 2 re-published.
recommendations.uncertain: Whether A3, which substitutes 'the rates in Schedule 1', reaches a monthly re-publication at all (C), or 'later' means later-effective (B).

recommendations.basis: Clause 18 builds every charge from the Schedule 1 rate; the instruments substitute for Schedule 1 rates; the standby percentage is stated as a percentage of the operating rate. Nothing says a monthly rate is all-in.
recommendations.uncertain: The instruments call it 'the rate chargeable'. If AMB-07 is approved as recommended, this affects only HC-601 on Standby days.

recommendations.basis: The only operative sentence says 'metres already drilled on the well in the Contract Year'.
recommendations.uncertain: The heading and the column say 'in the Contract Year' without 'well'. Under PER_WELL no well reaches 40,000 m in this data, so the tiers never engage; that is context, not evidence, but it is why this needs your judgment.

regrade.note: The operative Schedule 2 Part 2 sentence expressly scopes the count to the metres already drilled 'on the well'; the heading and the column label only abbreviate it and state no contract-wide aggregation. The original LOW rested largely on the observation that no well reaches 40,000 m, which is context, not contractual evidence. PER_WELL stays MEDIUM rather than HIGH because the abbreviated labels leave a small textual tension.

recommendations.basis: 3A: 'each following Contract Year from that anniversary'; the extension sentence stops an extension's effective date from starting a year.
recommendations.uncertain: Only matters where the tiers engage (the contract-wide reading of AMB-10).

recommendations.basis: 31A addresses the conflict expressly: 'Schedule 6 states the same values ... as they stood when it was let, and Schedule 2D governs'.
recommendations.uncertain: Clause 31, the Form of Agreement and the Appendix G footnote cite Schedule 6; rank of Part IX (AMB-01).

recommendations.basis: Clause 38 measures 'the sum of the amounts of the services charged on an invoice'.
recommendations.uncertain: It only matters if an invoice carries a charge other than services and DS-900 (a 36A adjustment line, AMB-12). DS-900 is invoice-level and is priced when invoices are assembled, not in this phase.
